items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: played spot jobs with Ridley's band

ctx.x: Was this, didn't you play many spot jobs around during the time you were with Sam? Oh yeah. How do you play, I mean with other bands I'm talking about?

Yeah, we played spot jobs with Pierron's band, played spot jobs with Ridley's band. Yeah, all the bands. You see, played all these colored dance halls with Pierron, played all white. With Ridley, played white. Country club, Southern Yacht club.
No, no, what I mean is if you're working regular with Sam, and he's not working that night, would you take a job with another band? Oh yeah, yeah, if they need me, yeah.
